**Finding: deviation (high severity) — § 2.2 (p0013)**

Section 2.2 makes Vendor "Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — full-term exclusive dealing binding us, with no product-category narrowing, no 12-month limit, and no performance-based exit. That falls squarely in the rule's walk-away band and fails the fallback. It also directly conflicts with § 2.1 (no minimum quantity or purchase commitment) and § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity commitment and nothing restricts us from engaging any supplier).

Redline (validated, preferred position, modeled on the approved Atlas precedent): Vendor becomes a non-exclusive provider and we expressly retain the right to source the same services from third parties. The comment offers the fallback — a narrow 12-month category exclusivity terminating automatically on any SLA or delivery failure — if exclusivity matters commercially to Silverline.
